fields.description: The Woods Abode is a one- and two-bedroom apartment release at Sobha Sanctuary in Dubailand. Its published layouts separate the enclosed suite from balcony space, while landscaped resident facilities connect the homes with the wider park-focused community.

sources.label: The Woods Abode official brochure and residence plans
Sobha current property catalogue: delivery-year reference
Impala: Woods Abode dated selection and payment reference

overview: Abode has its own floor-plan collection and B-series unit examples. A type letter can include several variants across different levels, so compare the actual unit number and balcony rather than relying on a rounded project-wide area.
research.locationNote: Sobha locates The Woods Abode within Sobha Sanctuary in Al Yufrah, with road access through the surrounding Dubailand district. Confirm the selected building, route and outlook rather than treating a general community map as a unit pin.
research.priceNote: The current Sobha project page advertises AED 1.60m, subject to inventory. Its catalogue currently shows a two-bedroom selection. Impala lists lower-priced one-bedroom examples from an earlier dated selection; those are not confirmation that a home remains available at that price.
research.paymentNote: Impala advertises 20% booking, 20% during construction and60% on handover. This is a broker reference; the reviewed official page and brochure do not provide a dated payment calendar. Obtain the developer-issued schedule for the chosen home.
research.handoverNote: The current Sobha catalogue lists 2029. Secondary references quote Q4 2029; confirm the unit's contractual programme and handover arrangements.
